title: Towards Lightweight Reliability: Using Soft Prompts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.00919v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have seen widespread adoption across various domains, yet their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations - responses that are plausible-sounding but factually incorrect. In high-stakes domains, these errors can reduce trust and introduce real-world risk. To address this challenge, we present a parameter-efficient approach that uses soft prompts to mitigate hallucinated content and promote responsible abstention in generative question-answering (QA) tasks. translated_title: 迈向轻量级可靠性：使用软提示缓解大型语言模型中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已在各个领域得到广泛采用，但其可靠性常常受到幻觉问题的削弱——即那些听起来合理但事实错误的响应。在高风险领域，这些错误会降低信任并引入现实风险。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种参数高效的方法，利用软提示来缓解生成式问答（QA）任务中的幻觉内容，并促进负责任的弃答行为。我们的方法称为“负责任的对比软提示”（RCSP），使用复合损失函数来训练软提示，以平衡三个目标：抑制幻觉内容、在不确定性下鼓励弃答，以及保持或改善事实召回。为实现这些目标，我们将对比损失、课程学习和KL正则化纳入训练机制。我们在五个多样化的生成式QA数据集上评估了我们的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种参数高效的软提示方法（RCSP），通过复合损失训练来同时抑制幻觉、鼓励不确定时弃答并保持事实召回，从而轻量级地提升LLM在生成式问答中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a parameter-efficient soft prompt method (RCSP) that uses composite loss training to suppress hallucinations, encourage abstention under uncertainty, and maintain factual recall, thereby lightweight improving LLM reliability in generative QA.
